title: The Desert Animal That Almost Never Drinks Water

scenes.text: This desert animal almost never takes a sip.
The kangaroo rat lives in dry country where water is scarce.
It eats dry seeds, and its body makes water from them as it digests.
Its burrow is humid, so stored seeds soak up as much as 30 percent more moisture.
Its urine is so concentrated that almost no water is wasted.
A desert survivor with no water bottle. Just seeds.

description:
This desert animal almost never takes a sip.
Kangaroo rats get their water from dry seeds and waste very little, thanks to highly concentrated urine and specialized nasal passages.
Could you live on dry seeds alone? Comment below.
first_comment: What is the longest you have gone without a drink of water?
